page0.text:
"Tohsaka. I don't even need to think about that."
"W-why? Rin is violent, greedy, and as loud as a mynah. But you still want to be with her? Is that what you're into?"

page1.text:
"No, it's not like that, Illya.
This is about whether I'll obey her orders, and I'm willing to. I can't stop Zouken on my own, and I'm only alive thanks to Archer."

page2.text: "But... That's only because Archer is your..."

page3.text:
"I'll let Tohsaka give me orders. That makes me no different from a Servant, right? She can treat me like one if that's what she wants."
I look at Tohsaka for confirmation.

page4.text:
"..."
"Tohsaka? Hey, don't ignore me when I'm talking to you."

page5.text:
"Ah... Y-yeah. I'm glad you get it.
My Archer left his unfinished work to you, so we're in the same boat now. I'll work you hard to pay back that debt."
"Of course. I can't sleep at night unless I properly pay back my debts."
